lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regularly spaced high-luminance circular clusters organized in at least five distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill region and superior to the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Clear vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a geometric grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A well-defined horizontal linear ridge exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient (bright superior edge, dark inferior shadow) running parallel to the long axis of the body on the upper flank.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated silhouette consistent with a remora is visible attached to the ventral-lateral surface posterior to the pectoral fin.
